verification_policy: These records are sourced from the structured research corpus and remain partially_verified until acquisition, mechanics, and CaC availability are independently reconciled against canonical in-game evidence.

records.name: Apocalyptic Burst
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 161 "Scream Team vs. Dream Team"; research corpus reports a 45% Ultimate Finish bonus-slot reward.
records.skill_description: A rushing Strike Ultimate with an aura approach, flurry, and slam finisher; charging the initial kick can break guard.
records.mechanics_notes: The source describes an aura that cancels weak Ki Blasts and a charged initial kick that breaks guard and can interrupt an enemy Ultimate. Community testing reports hybrid Strike/Ki scaling and damage measurements, but exact multipliers are not independently verified.
records.combo_notes: Best used from reliable confirms or knockdowns because the startup is punishable on a miss; the charged route provides a guard-break conversion.
records.pve_notes: The anti-blast approach and charged guard break can be useful against defensive or beam-using AI, while the high Ki cost rewards deliberate setup.
records.pvp_notes: The charged guard-break and anti-blast properties create pressure, but long startup and whiff punishment remain important counterplay considerations.

records.name: Appetizing Rush
records.unlock_method: Character-locked roster skill; research corpus reports no shop entry or Create-a-Character acquisition path.
records.skill_description: A teleporting multi-hit Strike rush that attacks from behind and ends with a launcher.
records.mechanics_notes: The structured source reports a behind-the-opponent teleport followed by a melee sequence of roughly 10–12 observed hits. The source describes it as pure Strike damage with no absorption or healing behavior; exact multiplier data is not independently verified.
records.combo_notes: The teleport entry can convert from suitable openings, while the long multi-hit sequence is most reliable when the initial teleport connects cleanly.
records.pve_notes: Available as part of Android 21's roster kit and useful as a close-range Ultimate when the character has a safe confirm.
records.pvp_notes: The teleport entry changes the defender's facing and can beat passive blocking, but the initial approach still requires a valid opening.

records.name: Assault Rain
records.unlock_method: Expert Mission 9 "The Most Feared Majin"; research corpus reports reward slots tied to Ultimate Finish, plus TP Medal Shop rotations.
records.source_quest_or_shop: Expert Mission 9; TP Medal Shop rotations
records.skill_description: Fires upward and creates a rain of Ki Waves over the target area.
records.mechanics_notes: The source describes roughly ten lightly homing Ki Waves and identifies them as knockback Ki Blasts. Community testing reports approximately 15% total damage; exact current scaling and projectile behavior remain partially verified.
records.combo_notes: Most useful after a setup that limits movement or when controlling an area rather than relying on a single-target confirm.
records.pve_notes: The area coverage can pressure groups of AI enemies and protect recovery windows, although its raw damage is comparatively modest.
records.pvp_notes: Can function as area denial and pressure against approaches, but mobile opponents can avoid the rain and the activation requires appropriate setup.

records.name: Assault Vanish
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 131 "Fight of the Fusions! Vegito vs Gogeta"; research corpus reports a 25% Ultimate Finish reward and TP Medal Shop rotations.
records.skill_description: Teleports behind the opponent, with a hold option that keeps the user invisible longer and returns them to the starting position; usable during Boost Dash.
records.mechanics_notes: The source reports 100 Ki and 100 stamina, no damage, instant rear teleportation on a tap, and a hold-based feint that returns the user to the original position. These mechanics are sourced from the structured research corpus and remain partially verified.
records.combo_notes: Can extend strings after knockbacks, alter approach timing, and create back-turn opportunities; the hold version can be used as a feint.
records.pve_notes: Provides movement and repositioning utility, though its resource cost competes with direct damage Supers in PvE.
records.pvp_notes: The tap-versus-hold ambiguity can create movement and feint options, while the mixed Ki/stamina cost makes resource management important.

records.name: Atomic Blast
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 87 "Saiyan Battle"; research corpus reports a 26% Ultimate Finish reward and TP Medal Shop rotations.
records.skill_description: A chargeable Ki Wave whose timing and grounded position affect its damage.
records.mechanics_notes: The source describes two quick opening shots followed by the main wave, plus a just-release timing bonus and increased damage when used on the ground. Community measurements report roughly 5% base damage, while exact bonus scaling is undocumented.
records.combo_notes: The opening shots help hold the target for the main wave and make it suitable for selected knockback routes; optimal use depends on release timing.
records.pve_notes: Provides a low-cost ranged option with timing-based damage optimization, especially when enemies are held in place.
records.pvp_notes: The timing and grounded bonuses reward deliberate use, but the directional projectile is not treated as homing and exact current tracking behavior is not verified.
